allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Brand Concepts Limited has informed the Exchange about new ISIN received from Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL) with respect to Warrants issued to Promoter Group of the Company.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Brand Concepts Limited has informed the Exchange about Allotment of Warrants.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Brand Concepts Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting through Circular Resolution for Allotment of 6,10,000 Warrants Convertible into Equity shares of the company on preferential basis to Promoter & Promoter group of the company held on December 03, 2025.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Brand Concepts Limited has informed the Exchange about SEBI Regulation 30 (LODR) 2015, regarding Intimation of In-Principle received from both the Stock Exchange (NSE & BSE) for issuance of 6,10,000 warrants convertible into Equity Shares of the Company  on Preferential Basis to the Promoter Group of the Company aggregating to Rs. 19,99,58,000 at an issue price of Rs. 327.80/-.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Brand Concepts Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Resolution passed by circulation by Board of Directors for allotment of Equity Shares under ESOP 2020 scheme.

allot.subject: Shareholders meeting
allot.text: Brand Concepts Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Extraordinary General Meeting to be held on October 16, 2025, for issuance of 6,10,000 (Six Lakh Ten Thousand) warrants convertible into equity share of the company on preferential basis to the members of the Promoter/Promoter Group at an issue price of Rs. 327.80 per warrant (comprising Rs. 10/- face value and Rs. 317.80 premium), aggregating to Rs. 19,99,58,000

allot.subject: Issue of Securities
allot.text: Brand Concepts Limited has informed the Exchange about issue of 6,10,000 warrants convertible into equity shares of Face Value of Rs.10 Each of the company on preferential basis at an issue price of Rs.327.80 each (including premium amount of Rs.317.80 per warrant ) aggregating to Rs.19,99,58,000.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Brand Concepts Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on September 23, 2025 for the issue of 6,10,000 warrants convertible into equity shares of face value of Rs. 10 each of the company on preferential basis to Promoter/ Promoter group at an issue price of Rs.327.80 (Including premium of Rs. 317.80 each) aggregating to Rs. 19,99,58,000.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Brand Concepts Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on Jun 21, 2025. Outcome of the Resolution passed by circulation by the Board of Directors for allotment of Equity shares pursuant to the Scheme of Merger of IFF Overseas Private Limited ( Transferor Company ) with Brand Concepts Limited ( Transferee Company )
